mapper.select: SELECT customer_id FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ticker FROM community_watchlist WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at, ticker
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_watchlist (customer_id, ticker, created_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{ticker}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ticker = VALUES(ticker)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_watchlist WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND ticker = #{ticker}
